message: 親密に親睦会

name: Synn
message: 「So now that everyone's all set--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold it right there! Someone crucial still hasn't had their turn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I forgot about Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Alright then, let me introduce my prized ingredient.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong! Synn! It's yours!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh yeah, Synn-kun hasn't gone yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's right.」
However, Sasami's eggs were a no-go, and the vegetables were a total wipeout.
All that's left is--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rejected!」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't even said anything yet!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Goes without saying. It can only be whatever you've got hidden inside your jacket!」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Come on, Nanaka. Isn't that sexual harassment?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugaaaah!」

name: Misa
message: 「Whatever is the matter, Nanaka-san?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She surely cannot contain her indignation at the inevitable appearance of milk.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though milk is delicious.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, Nanaka! How about this: yogurt! Yogurt's fine, right!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the same thing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san, you mustn't be a picky eater. You won't grow big and strong.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huff, huff... Those are the last words I wanted to hear from Lolo-chan of all people...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is that supposed to mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, it doesn't change the fact that my contribution is milk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't act so proud! That's only because it's all you had!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Not everything here is something everyone likes, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Speaking of things everyone likes, curry rice and hamburger steaks are definite winners.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right~」

name: Misa
message: 「Those are just generally considered popular favorites, it's not my personal opinion!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't have to deny it so forcefully......」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, we're gonna mix it all together anyway. Likes and dislikes don't matter.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's true. Even though there are so many delicious-looking things here......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hot pot is non-negotiable. Now that we've decided, there's no backing down.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That is the mission bestowed upon us, the Student Council!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's really not that grand of a thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, if we're going through the trouble, it'd be nice if it's actually edible.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? We're eating every last bite.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh. That's Nanaka-chan for you\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「I seriously doubt we can make a proper meal. In the end, we'll just leave leftovers and throw them away. We really should have canceled this project.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to eat something delicious......」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm, wait a second...... If it's a dish that uses milk!」
I pick up the cookbook borrowed from the library and flip through its pages.

name: Synn
message: 「That's it, let's go with this!」

name: Synn
message: 「First, let's boil some water. We have a lot of things to boil this time, so it's going to be tough.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, maybe I'll do mine as a steamed bowl dish. That way it frees up a burner.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That'd be a big help」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then make it with plenty of hot water. I'll get the pot ready」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You two are so efficient~」

name: Ria
message: 「Totally in sync」

name: Synn
message: 「We've been cooking together since we were kids, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You look just like a married couple who've spent years side by side」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan! Quit flapping your gums and get your hands moving!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes ma'am!」

name: Misa
message: 「Urgh... This octopus is so cu--」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you okay? Want me to take over?」

name: Misa
message: 「This much is nothing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hyah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, savage!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, what to do with the ink...」

name: Ria
message: 「Octopus ink? I've heard of squid ink, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I don't really have a use for it, it just feels like a waste」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Can we use it for calligraphy?」

name: Misa
message: 「I doubt that's possible\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then I don't want it」

name: Synn
message: 「So anyway, I want you to drain the ink, but... Misa, are you sure you're okay? Let me do--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hyah! Hyah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, amazing...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly a case of treading on thin ice is easier than worrying about it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Makes no sense」

name: Synn
message: 「The problem isn't the octopus, it's this guy...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Tuna!」

name: Ria
message: 「It kind of feels like it's always staring at me, so it's a little scary...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even you get scared, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Just a little, okay, just a little!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even that side of you is wonderful, Senpai...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「With this much mass, it looks like it'll take a while just to thaw」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's where DIY comes in, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, we had a saw, didn't we」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing. It's just like a fish market」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder if we can fillet a catch this huge into three pieces with a saw」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's pushing it, even for us」

name: Synn
message: 「If we all work together, we'll manage somehow. Alright, I'm gonna cut, so can you hold the tuna down?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okaay」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, it's cold」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you wearing your work gloves properly? It's dangerous if you don't」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, oops」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, our eyes keep meeting no matter what」

name: Ria
message: 「Right...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehehe... Toro, fatty tuna... The legendary otoro-wait, no, snap out of it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't think about unnecessary stuff right now. Chopping up the tuna comes first」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it. Alright, here goes... One, two」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek! That's dangerous!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What was that sound just now...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Showing up like that means it actually hit a nerve, doesn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Are you okay?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Something like this is no big deal!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, this is a tough one」

name: Misa
message: 「T-This sound is--?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the matter of the tuna to me, Riesling Tooyama」
Unfazed by the wildly thrashing blade, Riesling stares straight at us with a cool expression.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, is today Friday the 13th?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No way. Stop it, Nanaka-chan\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Could it be, Jiiya-san. What on earth are you going to do with that...!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please call me Riesling」
Saying that, he wielded the chainsaw as if it were an extension of his own arm and silently sliced off the tail section.

name: Riesling
message: 「There, just like this」
Without breaking a sweat or losing his breath, Riesling brushed his hair back with a sweep and casually tossed the stopped chainsaw over to me.

name: Synn
message: 「T-Thank you very much」

name: Misa
message: 「Who might this extraordinarily stylish gentleman be...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's Jiiya」

name: Ria
message: 「He's the butler for Lolotte-chan's family, right」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am humbled that you remember me, Lady Ria」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. We can do it with this. That fatty tuna we've been dreaming of!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright everyone! Hold it down tight--」
Combining everyone's strength, we pin the tuna down.

name: Synn
message: 「Guhhh... what a wild beast...」
I pressed the wildly bucking chainsaw against the tuna's back.

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Harder...! Rub it against it harder! Ah, n-not there... no」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Aah... Synn, that's... am... amazing...! Aah, aah~~」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hurry...! Any more than this and... no, nooo! I'm going nuuumb」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, go right for the good part... ah, aahn, let it rip~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it! Uoooooh, here I go~~~!」
Just like that, I drove the chainsaw forward in one go, gouging right into it.

name: Synn
message: 「Did it!」
We got our hands on a slab of tuna!

name: Lolotte
message: 「You did it, President. We got the fatty otoro!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's all thanks to everyone helping out...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Save the tears of joy for when we eat. Now, on with the cooking!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Okaaay!」

name: Paqy
message: 「T-Toro...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Is something wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「N-No... it's nothing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, next is the kitchen knife. Synn, I'm leaving the rest to you」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, aren't you gonna do it, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gracefully passing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka can only use a rolling pin and a soba knife」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How clumsy~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't wanna hear that from you, Lolo!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--! Why are you assuming I can't do it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then give it a shot」

name: Lolotte
message: 「B-Blades are scary...」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, fine. I'll do it. Hand me the knife」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's split the work between you and me, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm plenty enough on my own」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, it's fine, it's fine」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, listen to what I'm saying--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa, Mr. President. You're really good at peeling potatoes~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I want to leave as much of the edible part as possible」

name: Misa
message: 「...It's a contest」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see who can peel a potato cleaner and faster--it's a match!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And here we go, folks! This highly anticipated showdown has begun. Joining me on commentary is Ria Kujou-san--thanks for being here」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you for having me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Both competitors have picked up their potatoes at nearly the exact same instant, and--」

name: Ria
message: 「These potatoes were grown to perfection, nourished by fertile soil and mineral-rich underground spring water」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They say the sharp temperature swings between day and night are also key to their flavor, though--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa there! Both contenders are right on the verge of finishing their very first potato!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Booth, come in, booth. Actually, there are only three potatoes here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which means this very next one will decide the entire match! Both players' peels have just hit the cutting board!」

name: Ria
message: 「My, what long, clean ribbons those are」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, which one will make a move on the final remaining potato!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Their hands just touched!! Whoa, what an intense glare-off--no, wait, they're gazing into each other's eyes, blushing, and just staying like that--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, quit turning this into a rom-com!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I am not!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... stop fooling around and keep a proper eye on the boiling water」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Teehee!」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan. Let's peel the onions together」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa. Could you cut the carrots into chunks?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha! Don't just start bossing us around on your own--hey, you're already working on the chicken」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry, I'm making sure the portions are completely even」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not the issue!」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you're done with that, slice the onions next」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you... *sniff*, listen to what people are saying!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, did that make you sad?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's the onions! *Sniffle*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Even while complaining, her hands are moving right along」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that everything for the prep?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Now we just need to start cooking, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「Stare--」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, would you like to do it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yay\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please let me do something too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then let's cheer Senpai on together!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood~\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「So I just need to stir-fry everything we just cut, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai... I'm sure you must be good at cooking too」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't get your hopes up too much, okay」
Ria-senpai puts the vegetables into the pot and quickly stir-fries them with a rice paddle.

name: Ria
message: 「And here goes this」
She splashes wine straight in.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek!」
At that, the pot bursts into huge flames! Lolotte ran away.

name: Ria
message: 「Mmmm, smells great」
However, Senpai isn't fazed at all.

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Lord summons thee, cradled in pure and innocent streams, Thrysel, Angel of Azure Water...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahahaha! Lolo-chan sure is a scaredy-cat~」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, I guess it's about time for the milk to make its entrance」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eeeek!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, the hot water, the hot water!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, sorry! I just couldn't help it.

name: Nanaka
message: Okay, it's boiled. The spot next to me is open~」

name: Ria
message: 「Cheese fondue. Could you melt it in a double boiler for me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You got iiit\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's put butter and flour into this pot. And blend them together so they don't burn, there」

name: Misa
message: 「So, where is the milk?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right here. Inside my jacket, right around here」

name: Misa
message: 「Ehh, i... in a place like that!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's see here」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... ngh, aah~~~, Senpai, not there\s08」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey! Stop making weird noises, Synn-kun, jeez~\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry... it was so sudden it startled me\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「You really do keep it stocked at all times...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, add the milk little by little and stir...」

name: Misa
message: 「Looks like we add more wine next」

name: Synn
message: 「Wine upon wine, huh. Feels super fancy」

name: Ria
message: 「This side's getting a nice brown sear too」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's get it simmering!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're gonna make some sobagaki」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, ma'am!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You pour hot water into the bowl of buckwheat flour like this, then stir it round and round with a wooden pestle」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa, whoaaa! It's starting to get all sticky and stretchy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, look, lumps are forming, so mash 'em down as you go」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-yes, ma'am!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that's a great buckwheat aroma」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's prep the base before it cools down」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Arrange the tuna, octopus, and onions nicely...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of dressing are we using?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since it's sobagaki, Japanese-style should work」

name: Ria
message: 「Awesome!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now we just need to plate the fish and chips alongside it, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mm-hm. A brilliant harmony of light and rich」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huff, huff... Treasurer. How does this look for the sobagaki?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Spot-on, spot-on! You've got great instincts, Lolo. Wanna come work at my place?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Really!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My training's tough, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then I'll quit」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Spineless!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! Seafood and sobagaki carpaccio... sound good?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Super stylish--looks great!」

name: Ria
message: 「This one's done toooo」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, it's just a completely ordinary cream stew, though」

name: Synn
message: 「It turned out to be a proper hot pot dish, didn't it」

name: Helena
message: 「I made a proper yaminabe too, you know\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's amazing~. Somehow it ended up looking like a normal meal」

name: Ria
message: 「And with French bread and cheese fondue as the main dish--」

name: Everyone
message: 「All done!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Let's eat!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is sobagaki. It has an interesting taste~」

name: Ria
message: 「Mmm--. It's so chewy--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Both the octopus and the tuna are delicious~. Tossed with onions, I'll gobble them right up!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even the greasiness of the fish and chips pairs nicely with the refreshing carpaccio」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Crispy and piping hot--it's delicious」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, magnificent otoro... To think the day I'd get to eat fatty tuna would come so soon」

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong, Paa-chan」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, about that tuna...」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't want yours, Paqy? Then I'll eat it for you」

name: Paqy
message: 「You cut that off the back, didn't you. That's just plain akami」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--what are you saying? It's delicious, so this is otoro!\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Come to think of it, it does seem a bit low in fat...」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai, if you say that--」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hate to break it to ya, but that otoro was--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Tuna... we really can't finish all of you, can we?」

name: Riesling
message: 「If it is in the way, I shall dispose of it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That would be such a waste!! You helped out too, so please go ahead and have the rest, Jeeves.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Very well. Um, Milady--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am deeply grateful for your kindness.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now, it's still delicious tuna either way. Since we're at it, I think I'll try some with wasabi and soy sauce.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that kick--delicious! How about the rest of you?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm good. I'll pass, thanks\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Being so modest is what makes you cute, Ria-chan!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll pass on the wasabi as well.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't even eat wasabi? You really are just a kid, Hisa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? I-I'll eat it! Happy if I eat it, right?! *Munch*」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to force yourself to eat it.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's delicious, really!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, glad to hear it! That's Yuugiri-an's special house wasabi, after all. Use as much as you want!」
Thanks to that, the soy sauce seems to be going down at a brisk pace, too.

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna give yourself high blood pressure if you pour that much on」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh... That's not the issue...\s06」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please let me have a bite, too! Ahh, chomp」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well? Tasty, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaa, it's spicy!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's freshly grated wasabi, after all. It packs quite a punch.」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone's pushing through... I'll give it a try, too... Maybe it'll actually taste good」

name: Ria
message: 「Here goes, nom」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh!」

name: Ria
message: 「Mmmmmph!? So spicy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mwahahaha! Seeing Ria-chan squirm in agony is super cute!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whack!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaah!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Have some stew to cleanse your palate...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haah... It's so warm and delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Totally! It's super creamy and comforting, isn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, Nanaka-chan. Are you okay with milk?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, it's completely cooked down past its original form anyway. Totally fine」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that how it works」

name: Synn
message: 「Remember what her favorite food is. Cake, guys, cake」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... Cake does have plenty of milk in it, doesn't it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Saying stew and cake are fine, yet milk is off-limits. You really are quite selfish, Treasurer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan, you really want to eat wasabi that badly, huh\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek, please don't put it in the stew!」

name: Misa
message: 「Melted cheese fondue on French bread. This is simply delicious~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't you dare leave that sashimi from earlier unfinished」

name: Misa
message: 「Bringing that up again...」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew~~. Man, I'm stuffed」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My tummy is completely, totally full~」

name: Ria
message: 「Totally, totally. I might've gone and eaten a bit too much」

name: Synn
message: 「And now, the moment you've been waiting for--dessert」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't want it! I don't want any!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're not allowed to leave anything unfinished, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr, you're a demon. There's an ogre right here!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the very last person I want to hear that from, Nanaka-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go, enjoy the yogurt!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh, urgh, urgh...」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for the food~」

name: Ria
message: 「Nom, mmm--yummy♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. This yogurt is just sour and isn't sweet at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, of course it isn't. It's just plain yogurt, after all」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plus it's homemade Caspian Sea yogurt, man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way we can eat this! Let's all give up together, okay! If everyone crosses on a red light--」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Where might the sugar be...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betrayed meee!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pass me some sugar too, pleaseee」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heartless traitorss!」

name: Ria
message: 「You got this, Nanaka-chan♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... Here goes」

name: Synn
message: 「Just close your eyes and you'll be fine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okay, I'll try」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmm~ It's so sweet and delicious♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah, it is...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even with my eyes closed, it still tastes like yogurt!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the meal! Man, I'm stuffed and satisfied」

name: Ria
message: 「Even with a crazy combination like that, we managed to make it fun and tasty」

name: Misa
message: 「When I first saw the ingredients, I really wondered how it was going to turn out, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Things always work out somehow」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So by combining everyone's strength, we made the impossible possible」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yogurt, finished!」

name: Ria
message: 「Congrats!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, let's start cleaning up soon」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hold on a second. There's still something left」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait... Even though we set those aside to make stew」
A clay pot bubbles and simmers away on the stove.

name: Synn
message: 「Who made that?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Who knows...」
Everyone blinks in wide-eyed bewilderment.
Who on earth could have set up a trap like this?

name: Paqy
message: 「Could it be--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ugya!」
Paqy collapses face-down without a sound. Eh, leave him be.

name: Synn
message: 「For now, let's try opening the lid」
The grand unveiling.
And curtain close.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a seconddddd!」

name: Synn
message: 「Octopus, tuna, buckwheat dumplings, potatoes, carrots, onions, chicken...」

name: Synn
message: 「Fish and chips, wine, and cheese fondue all boiled down in milk and yogurt?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we run away, we lose... Because running means losing...!」

name: Ria
message: 「N-Nanaka... your eyes look dangerous」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today's rule was 'no leaving any food behind,' wasn't it」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte, have you lost your mind?!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Got it. Since we decided on it, we just have to do it!」
The stew from the pot is served into everyone's bowls. And all at once--

name: Everyone
message: 「Thanks for the meal!」
